header: Cover and clearances behind every booking
subheadline: All of this comes with every standard consignment note, with nothing to request. Insurance applies per consignment, and customs status covers 11 crossings on the eastern lanes.

badge_items.label: AEO-F customs status
badge_items.description_text: Trusted-trader clearance at 11 border crossings, 41 minutes on average per bonded load.

badge_items.label: Cargo insured to EUR 1.2 m
badge_items.description_text: Cover applies per consignment, with claims settled in a median of 9 days.

badge_items.label: GDP-compliant cold chain
badge_items.description_text: Load kept at 2 to 8 °C and logged every 4 minutes. Records are kept for 5 years.
